words.sense: Remaining in the same condition without meaningful change or development.
misconceptions: Any object that is not moving is best called static.

words.sense: Not changing physical location or moving through space.
misconceptions: An unchanged plan must be stationary.

semantic_axes.description: Static emphasizes an unchanged state or lack of development; stationary specifically means staying in one physical place.

edges.boundary_rule: Static emphasizes an unchanged state or lack of development; stationary specifically means staying in one physical place.

misconceptions.M1: Any object that is not moving is best called static.
misconceptions.M2: An unchanged plan must be stationary.
misconceptions.M3: Activity within an unmoving object means it cannot be stationary.

chains.frame: Which word best describes the school website Amira manages?

beats.text: Amira’s school website has shown the same notices, timetable, and links for two years.
beats.decisive_clue: the content and layout have not developed
beats.reason: The website has undergone no meaningful revision.

beats.text: Students still open the site from their phones every day.
beats.reason: Visitor activity does not change the content.

chains.feedback_short: A website can remain unchanged even when hundreds of people visit it.
chains.feedback_deep: Static describes a lack of change or development. Stationary means physically unmoving, which is not the relevant property of a website.
chains.contrast_rule: Static stays the same; stationary stays in the same place.

hints.attention: Track changes to the website itself.
hints.axis: Static emphasizes an unchanged state or lack of development; stationary specifically means staying in one physical place.
hints.contrast: Static stays the same; stationary stays in the same place.

chains.frame: Which word best describes the practice car Mei is watching?

beats.text: The practice car waited at the marked stop line without moving forward.
beats.reason: The fact concerns movement in space.

beats.text: Its engine was running and its turn signal blinked.
beats.decisive_clue: did not move despite active engine and lights
beats.reason: Internal activity does not move the car from its location.

chains.feedback_short: The car remained in place although its engine and lights were active.
chains.feedback_deep: Stationary concerns position, not whether every part is silent or inactive. Static usually describes an unchanged condition rather than a vehicle stopped on the road.
chains.contrast_rule: Static stays the same; stationary stays in the same place.

hints.attention: Look at the car’s position on the road.
hints.axis: Static emphasizes an unchanged state or lack of development; stationary specifically means staying in one physical place.
hints.contrast: Static stays the same; stationary stays in the same place.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Diego’s membership plan?

beats.text: Diego’s club kept the same fees, benefits, and joining rules through three seasons.
beats.reason: The plan did not develop over time.

beats.text: The plan remained unchanged when its printed leaflet was moved to a different display stand.
beats.decisive_clue: membership terms stayed unchanged despite leaflet relocation
beats.reason: Moving the paper does not alter the plan.

chains.feedback_short: Moving a leaflet does not change the fees or benefits it describes.
chains.feedback_deep: Static refers to unchanging conditions. The physical movement of a printed copy is irrelevant when the subject is the membership plan itself.
chains.contrast_rule: Static stays the same; stationary stays in the same place.

hints.attention: Which thing is the question asking you to classify?
hints.axis: Static emphasizes an unchanged state or lack of development; stationary specifically means staying in one physical place.
hints.contrast: Static stays the same; stationary stays in the same place.

chains.frame: Which word best describes the bus Noor noticed?

beats.text: The bus remained beside the same platform while passengers got on.
beats.reason: The bus itself did not change location.

beats.text: The driver opened the doors, checked tickets, and spoke to passengers.
beats.decisive_clue: bus position remained fixed while tasks continued
beats.reason: Activities inside do not constitute movement of the vehicle.

chains.feedback_short: Boarding and ticket checks did not move the bus from its platform.
chains.feedback_deep: Stationary means remaining in one place. The bus can still be a busy setting; being physically still does not require complete inactivity.
chains.contrast_rule: Static stays the same; stationary stays in the same place.

hints.attention: Distinguish the bus from what happens aboard it.
hints.axis: Static emphasizes an unchanged state or lack of development; stationary specifically means staying in one physical place.
hints.contrast: Static stays the same; stationary stays in the same place.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Hana’s remote-work policy?

beats.text: Hana’s office has used exactly the same remote-work rules for five years.
beats.decisive_clue: rules have not changed in years
beats.reason: The subject is an enduring condition, not a location.

beats.text: Employees now work from three buildings, but all follow those unchanged rules.
beats.decisive_clue: rules remain identical despite multiple work sites
beats.reason: The workers’ locations do not change the policy.

chains.feedback_short: Different workplaces do not make the policy itself move or develop.
chains.feedback_deep: Static is appropriate for a rule or arrangement that does not evolve. Stationary applies to physical position and is not the natural label for unchanged rules.
chains.contrast_rule: Static stays the same; stationary stays in the same place.

hints.attention: Focus on the policy, not the buildings.
hints.axis: Static emphasizes an unchanged state or lack of development; stationary specifically means staying in one physical place.
hints.contrast: Static stays the same; stationary stays in the same place.

chains.frame: Which word best describes the bench Kofi sat beside?

beats.text: The heavy bench stayed in its marked spot throughout the busy afternoon.
beats.reason: The issue is whether the bench moved.

beats.text: The advertisement on its backrest changed from one picture to another.
beats.decisive_clue: bench position stayed fixed despite changing advert
beats.reason: An updated image does not relocate the bench.

chains.feedback_short: The bench stayed in place even though its displayed advertisement changed.
chains.feedback_deep: Stationary refers to an object not moving from its location. Its decoration or content may change; that is different from physical movement.
chains.contrast_rule: Static stays the same; stationary stays in the same place.

hints.attention: Observe where the bench is, not what is printed on it.
hints.axis: Static emphasizes an unchanged state or lack of development; stationary specifically means staying in one physical place.
hints.contrast: Static stays the same; stationary stays in the same place.
